summary: Overdue hunter located in the Dunckley Pass area after a ~3 p.m. page during the first rifle hunting season; 6 inches of snow on the ground with more on the way and temperatures dropping; located just after dark by sheriff's deputies and Colorado Parks and Wildlife officers (first of three RCSAR pages within 14 hours).
responding_agency: Rio Blanco County Sheriff's Office; Routt County Search and Rescue (assist); Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Freshness sweep run 33: Steamboat Pilot via operanewsapp mirror (published 2026-10-20) + KZYR Zephyr Press Oct-16 newscast; RCSAR paged 3x in 14 hours during first rifle season and the first significant snowstorm.
